title: Analgesic Efficacy of Capsaicin 8% Patch (QUTENZA®) in Coccygodygnia
official: Neuropathic Determining Factors and Analgesic Efficacy of Capsaicin 8% (QUTENZA®) Patches in Refractory Coccygodygnia
summary: A retrospective study over a period of 6 years to explore analgesic efficacy of 8% Capsaicin patch (QUTENZA®) in coccygodynic patients, as well as neuropathic predictive factors of therapeutic response.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who received topical Capsaicin 8% patch therapy for the treatment of their coccygodygnia between August 2016 and August 2022

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have already received 8% Capsaicin patch topical treatment in coccyx area.
